title: Super Wallet
tagline: Simple mobile number based wallet using ghost and account abstration
description: We are the first platform agnostic phone number based wallet, no matter if its vis SMS , whatsapp or telegram, your wallet is related to your phone number, you can send/received payments via whatsapp using account abstraction. Imagine people in argentina with hyper inflation sending simple messages to protect them selfs from inflation.
how_its_made: We are using telegram API, whatsapp api and twilio to send messages for the interface. In the backend everything is releaed to your phone number so we are using biconomy account abstraction to create wallets for every phone number. At this moment we are using biconmy gas tank to sponsor the transactions to make a better UX
